comparison.objective: Visually select and pack two intact tiles while excluding both halves of a broken tile; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Damage-state recognition and careful tile packing versus precision tool alignment, controlled striking, and tiny-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Both intact tiles inside the box and neither broken half inside, with no partial credit versus four physical fractures and all released fragments contained safely.
comparison.reason: Defect sorting and packing do not exercise the candidate's hardware-finishing ability.
